text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh, can you hear that? Even before the 
race, the cheers are making the ground 
rumble!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, THIS is the 'Japanese Derby'! El 
just learned that right now!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And El can see it... El can see it now, 
yes...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
After the race on this stage today... what 
kind of words will be exchanged between 
them...!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A clean win, a huge win, an El victory! 
This year's Derby Umamusume is El Condor 
Pasaaaa DEEEESU!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aww, I lost! El-chan, what kind of 
training have you been doing~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but of course! It's obvious she'd be 
strong. El-chan is aiming to be the 
world's strongest, after all..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That is correct, yes! What we've done and 
the races we've run are completely 
different from everyone else's!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"So, it's only natural that they're that 
much stronger, DESU!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's face off again next time! 
And the next, and the next, and the next! 
I wanna race with El-chan forever!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe... I'm sure it'll turn out 
something like this...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As a warrior of strength, today I 
must—show my might!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Riding upon the wind known as 
sportsmanship, majestic and proud—!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go show Spe-chan that being the 
world's strongest also means being the 
strongest of our generation, desu!
